support_story_1_headline: Mba eren akaa ka vea za hemen yô, ior mba hen ijiir la ve mough sha.
support_story_1_lead: U kuran ikyagh you ki tomough sha ikyev i akaa a a lu a zwa ga la man akaa a i hide i sôr la.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis ka a due a akaa a he a i yer ér firmwares la sha ci u mbayev mba eren anumbe er Y1 nahan (ka a ver ishima sha akaa a i yer ér hidden board revisions er 6.0, 7.0, man 8.0 nahan) a a vihi akaa a tse la ken myer yô. Kwagh u hemban vihin yô, ijiir ve i sha Intanet ne ngi tan ior icin ga, shi ngi a ian i nyôron ken akaa a yange er tom la sha er vea hide a lu ken mlu u ve lu ker la ga yô. Updater man tom u i yer ér Community Firmware la ka ve tôô akaa la: se koso hanma ROM u i vande lun a mi la cii, se nenge ser kwagh u u lu eren la ka u vough, shi se nenge ser kwagh u u lu eren tom a mi la ngu eren tom tsembelee.

support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: I kohol akaa a yange i hii eren ken ijiirtom la cii, nahan i vihi akaa a i yer ér Innioasis la kera.
support_story_1_item_3: Ior mba ve lu a ikyagh ki tomough ki ki lu a ikyav mbi tomov mbi i yer ér macOS man Linux man Windows la cii.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Ka a fa kwagh u a lu ken board la iyol na sha er u zua a kwagh u u soo la hanma shighe yô.
support_story_2_headline: Google Drive mba vihin ga. Tom u henen kwagh ngu ga. Ka firmware u eren tom tseegh.
support_story_2_lead: Ior mba hen ijiir you mba ve lu a akaa a eren tom fele fele, a i nenge ér ka mimi yô, u fatyô u suur sha mi jighilii.
support_story_2_body: Ka sea ôron kwagh u mlu u ken hemen yô, se nenge ser se mba keren akaa a Google Drive a a bee shighe la, man akaa a Baidu cloud shares a a kpe la, kua akaa a myer a i yer ér mystery zip files la, a a lu a ikyav mbi tomov mbi eren tom ga yô. Se maa ikyagh ki eren tom a mi ki ior vea na jighjigh a mi, ki ki lu sha tseeneke u ki, ki ki lu a SHA-256 u i tese ér ki ngu vough yô, shi ki lu a akaa a i gber sha mi la, shi ki lu a akaa a i gber sha mi la kpaa. Iyua you ka i kura akaa a u danlood man hosting u a ne ve kwagh ne a lu eren la jighilii ahwa 24 ken iyange, ayange 365 ken inyom.

support_story_2_item_4: Ior mba lamen ijô kpishi: I lamen zwa Buter man zwa China man zwa Jamani man zwa Ishpania man zwa French man zwa Japanese.
support_story_3_headline: U bughun tahav mbu or u nan lu eren anumbe a Innioasis la cii.
support_story_3_lead: U van a Rockbox, akaa a eren tom a mi a a lu a ikyav mbi yuhwan ga, man ian i ungwan kwagh sha tseeneke wou.
support_story_3_body: Ior mba ve lu a ikyagh ki tomough ki i yer ér Stock factory la, ka ve nger kwagh u ikyagh ki tomough ki Y1 shin Y2 ki ki lu a mi la tseegh. Ior mba hen ijiir yase la yange ve va a Rockbox, man ikyav mbi tomov mbi ior ve eren tom a mi sha inja la, man ikyav mbi ungwan mbi i yer ér audiophile codec la, kua akaa a ior ve eren tom a mi la. Ka se yam akaa a i yer ér physical hardware la ken akpa a ase sha u se kar a, se hide se sôr akaa agen, shi se nenge ser hanma kwagh u i we ker cii ka u mimi. U suen Updater la ka a na inyaregh sha u karen akaa ne jighilii shi a wase u u eren akaa a i yer ér firmware la fese.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Ka i wa akaa a ungwan man akaa a i gber sha inja la ken atô u sekonde kpuaa.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware u hen ijiir: U seer mlu u bateri, UI u wang, man iwasen i codec u ungwan kwagh u ainge ne.
